post.description:
Propose an action and get the policy engine's decision.

- `allow`: the action ran; `cart` is the new cart.
- `reject`: nothing changed; `error` says why.
- `confirm`: nothing changed yet; ask the customer, then confirm or cancel
  using `pending_action_id`.
- `escalate`: the session has been handed to a person.

post.description:
For a presenter who wants to talk without the session timing out.

While paused, no timer fires and the time does not count toward the
session's length. Pausing twice is the same as pausing once. The session
also resumes by itself as soon as the customer says something.
Run the stored action, now that the customer has confirmed it.

The customer gets a fresh stretch of silence before being asked
whether they are still there.

Send the browser's SDP offer; get OpenAI's SDP answer back.

The call is set up with the same instructions and tools as text mode,
and the backend joins it to run every tool call through the policy
gateway.
